prerequisites.reason: Backpropagation is specifically defined as an algorithm for training neural networks, so understanding neural network structure is necessary first.
Backpropagation updates weights based on error gradients derived from a loss, so understanding loss functions is necessary.
Backpropagation computes gradients through neural network nodes, which requires understanding activation functions used at those nodes.
Deep learning is a subset focused on neural networks with many layers, so neural networks are foundational knowledge.
Activation functions are defined as functions determining the output of a neural network node, so neural networks must be understood first.
Inference here refers to making predictions using a trained model, and in this topic set it depends on understanding the neural network model being used.
